business-portfolio.title: Create a business portfolio
business-portfolio.intro: The business portfolio groups your Pages and ad accounts at Meta.
business-portfolio.step_1: Open business.facebook.com and sign in with your Facebook account.
business-portfolio.step_2: Create a business portfolio named after your business.
business-portfolio.step_3: Add your Page and your ad account to this portfolio.
business-portfolio.step_4: Come back here and press “Check again”.
business-portfolio.note: This step happens on Facebook: Pubeka does not create anything for you.

ad-account.title: Create an ad account
ad-account.intro: Without an ad account, Pubeka cannot publish. It is the only required item.
ad-account.step_1: Open Meta’s ads manager from your business portfolio.
ad-account.step_2: Create an ad account: choose your country, time zone and currency.
ad-account.step_3: Check that it is active (not disabled, not unpaid).
ad-account.step_4: Come back here and press “Check again”.
ad-account.note: This step happens on Facebook: Pubeka does not create anything for you.

payment-method.title: Add a payment method
payment-method.intro: Meta charges your ads to your ad account. Without a valid payment method, they are not delivered.
payment-method.step_1: In Meta Ads Manager, open “Payment settings”.
payment-method.step_2: Add the payment method Meta offers for your account’s country and currency. A bank card or PayPal is used for automatic billing: Meta charges you when you reach your payment threshold.
payment-method.step_3: If your account offers available funds (prepayment), you top them up yourself before delivery: plan enough to cover your campaign, because delivery can stop when the funds run out. According to Meta, they are only offered in some countries, with local methods (for example M-Pesa in Kenya).
payment-method.step_4: No bank card? You can use a virtual card, for example Keecash, or your own virtual card; check that Meta accepts it before using it. Then come back here.
payment-method.note: Ads are paid to Meta, never to Pubeka. The Pubeka subscription is paid separately, by Mobile Money. Available payment methods depend on your account’s country and currency: check in the Meta Help Center (links below).
payment-method.source_1: Meta Help Center: available funds and automatic billing
payment-method.source_2: Meta Help Center: accepted payment methods for available funds

facebook-page.title: Create a Facebook Page
facebook-page.intro: Your ads are published in the name of a Facebook Page.
facebook-page.step_1: On Facebook, open the “Pages” menu then “Create a Page”.
facebook-page.step_2: Enter your business name, pick a category and add your logo.
facebook-page.step_3: Add the Page to your business portfolio.
facebook-page.step_4: Come back here and press “Check again”.
facebook-page.note: This step happens on Facebook: Pubeka does not create anything for you.

instagram.title: Link Instagram
instagram.intro: Optional: your ads can also appear on Instagram.
instagram.step_1: Switch your Instagram account to a professional account.
instagram.step_2: In your Facebook Page settings, link this Instagram account.
instagram.step_3: Confirm the link in the Facebook window.
instagram.step_4: Come back here and press “Check again”.
instagram.note: Instagram is optional: you can publish without it.

whatsapp-business.title: Link WhatsApp Business
whatsapp-business.intro: Strongly recommended: customers contact you in one tap from your ad.
whatsapp-business.step_1: Install the WhatsApp Business app and create your account with your number.
whatsapp-business.step_2: In your business portfolio, add your WhatsApp Business account.
whatsapp-business.step_3: Link the number to your Facebook Page.
whatsapp-business.step_4: Come back here and press “Check again”.

pixel.title: Install a pixel
pixel.intro: Optional: the pixel measures what visitors do on your site after clicking your ad.
pixel.step_1: In Meta’s events manager, create a pixel (or a dataset).
pixel.step_2: Install it on your site: Shopify, WordPress and Wix each have a field for the pixel code.
pixel.step_3: For a custom site, paste the code in the header of every page.
pixel.step_4: Come back here and press “Check again”.
pixel.note: Without a pixel, Pubeka still publishes.

permissions.title: Grant the permissions
permissions.intro: Pubeka needs all the permissions requested to create and track your campaigns.
permissions.step_2: In the Facebook window, keep every permission turned on.
permissions.step_3: If a permission is still missing, remove Pubeka in Facebook’s settings, then reconnect.
permissions.step_4: Come back here and press “Check again”.
permissions.note: Pubeka only asks for what is needed to create and track your campaigns.

ad-account-currency.title: Use a currency Meta accepts
ad-account-currency.intro: Meta only accepts a list of currencies for ad accounts (official list checked on 18 October 2026). Among African currencies, it includes the Algerian dinar (DZD), the Egyptian pound (EGP), the Kenyan shilling (KES), the naira (NGN) and the rand (ZAR). The CFA franc (XAF, XOF) and most other African currencies are not on it.
ad-account-currency.step_1: In Meta Ads Manager, open “Payment settings”, then “Business info” and “Edit”.
ad-account-currency.step_2: Choose an accepted currency, for example US dollars (USD), then save. Meta then creates a new ad account: the old one is closed and its ads stop.
ad-account-currency.step_3: According to Meta, you can only change currency once every 60 days if you have no current balance, and not at all with monthly invoicing. The payment methods offered depend on the currency you choose.
ad-account-currency.step_4: Come back here, press “Check again” in the Meta settings, then publish.
ad-account-currency.note: This step happens at Meta: Pubeka neither creates nor changes your ad account.

rejection.banner_title_partial: Meta rejected ad {variant} of your test
rejection.banner_body_ready: We explain why and suggest a fix.
rejection.banner_body_pending: We are writing your explanation. It will appear here in a moment.
rejection.banner_body_failed: Here is the reason Meta gave, with what you can do.
rejection.banner_body_partial: Your campaign keeps running the other ad.
rejection.title: Why Meta rejected your ad
rejection.not_found: This rejection does not exist in this workspace.
rejection.ad_as_sent: Your ad as it was sent
rejection.culprit_not_text: This element is fixed in the image or on the page, not in the text: use “Edit it myself”.
rejection.culprit_unknown: Meta does not point to a specific element, and we cannot see one in your ad either.
rejection.culprit_product: The rejection is about the product itself, not how you wrote it.
rejection.fix_none: There is no corrected text to suggest for this rejection.
rejection.fix_manual: This fix concerns {field}: make it yourself, we cannot apply it in one click.
rejection.no_republish: There is nothing to republish for this product.
rejection.prohibited_title: Meta does not allow this product
rejection.prohibited_body: No corrected text will change this decision: the rejection comes from the product, not from how you wrote it.
rejection.pending_body: This takes a few moments. This page updates by itself.
rejection.failed_title: The report could not be written
rejection.failed_body: Here is the reason Meta gave. You can edit your ad yourself or ask for another review.
rejection.partial_notice: Only ad {variant} is rejected. Your campaign keeps running the other ad.
rejection.partial_no_apply: One-click republishing is for campaigns rejected as a whole. For ad {variant}, edit it yourself.
rejection.read_only: Your workspace is read-only: you can read this report, but not republish.
rejection.viewer: Only the owner and editors can republish.
rejection.confirm_body: Fixing recreates your campaign on Meta: your text is replaced by the fix, then Meta reviews your ad again. This republication does not count as a new campaign in your plan.
rejection.confirm_warning: Before recreating the campaign, Pubeka removes the old rejected campaign from Meta. You will then no longer be able to ask for another review of it: if you think Meta made a mistake, ask for another review first. If Meta no longer shows it as rejected, nothing is changed.
rejection.appeal_intro: If you think Meta made a mistake, you can ask for a second review. It does not hurt your account.
rejection.appeal_step_2: Choose the ad account that contains the rejected ad.
rejection.appeal_step_3: Select the ad or campaign that was rejected by mistake.
rejection.appeal_delay: Meta aims to answer within 48 hours.
rejection.appeal_warning: Do not delete the ad first: you might lose the option to ask for this review.
rejection.appeal_source: Meta help page on rejected ads
rejection.error_publish_disabled: Real publishing is turned off for now: nothing was sent to Meta.
rejection.error_fix_not_applicable: This fix cannot be applied in one click. Edit your ad yourself.
rejection.error_partial_rejection: Only one of the two ads is rejected: the campaign is not republished as a whole.
rejection.error_already_fixed: This rejection has already been fixed and republished.
rejection.error_not_explained: The report is not ready yet. Try again in a moment.
rejection.error_validation: Your campaign does not pass the checks before publishing. Fix it, then try again.
rejection.error_read_only: Your workspace is read-only: nothing was republished.
rejection.error_no_longer_rejected: Meta no longer shows this campaign as rejected (it may have been approved after an appeal). Nothing was changed: check its status on Meta.
rejection.republish_failed_title: The republication did not go through
rejection.republish_failed_still_live: Your old campaign is still on Meta and is no longer rejected: check its status on Meta. Nothing was created.
rejection.republish_failed_unreadable: Pubeka could not read the state of your old campaign on Meta. Nothing was created: try again in a moment.
rejection.republish_failed_not_removed: Your old campaign could not be removed from Meta: it is still there and nothing was created. Try again, or check its status on Meta.
rejection.republish_failed_other: The new campaign was not created on Meta.
rejection.republish_failed_open: This rejection stays open until the republication goes through: you can try again.
rejection.banner_body_republish_failed: The republication did not go through. The rejection stays open: here is what happened.
rejection.publishing_body: Pubeka is recreating your campaign on Meta. Nothing has reached Meta until this step is done: this page updates when it is.
